title: Two-person standup
description: A clean two-party call: the user (mic) and Ana (far end). Carries the core decisions.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Morning Ana, thanks for jumping on. Shall we go through the queue worker first?

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: Sure. The consumer kept crashing on malformed messages over the weekend, and every crash replayed the same batch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Right. So what did we land on for retries?

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: The retry budget is three attempts, then dead-letter. After the third failure the message goes to the dead letter queue.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Good. Three attempts, then dead-letter. I'll write that into the runbook today.

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: The schema migration is ready as well. I tested it against a copy of production last night.

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: The migration lands Thursday, after the morning deploy freeze lifts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Thursday works. Who is looking after the metrics dashboard while Ben is away?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: So to confirm, Ana owns the dashboard until Ben is back.

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: Yes. I'll keep the alerts tidy. The only blocker is the staging certificate.

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: On Friday. I'll renew it this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Perfect. Let's wrap there. Talk tomorrow.
